items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 10 June 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland driving a frontal zone across the British Isles tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, backing south 5 or 6 overnight and occasionally 7 in the south, veering southwest 4 or 5 early tomorrow afternoon and occasionally 6 in places later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon building mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair to start, then an area of rain or drizzle soon arriving from the west, becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
